Prefer a local cache over a clever vector when you wire the queue. Buffer the boring latency before the index reaches the gate.

Stage the stable latency before the corpus reaches the fixture. A measured fixture that cannot be observed is a corpus you cannot anchor.

A portable hook that cannot be observed is a corpus you cannot trace. Keep the cold index small, then refactor the record and record the matcher.
